briefing.summary: VMC throughout, destination weather visual. Pilot decides to cancel IFR and continue VFR to save flight time.

challenge.expectedText: Brisbane Centre, Lima Echo Foxtrot, cancelling IFR, continuing VFR.

elements.label: Cancel IFR phrase
elements.hint: Use the explicit phrase — 'cancel IFR'. Centre needs this to terminate IFR service and SAR.

elements.label: VFR continuation
elements.hint: State your intent so Centre knows you're maintaining VMC and self-navigating.

challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.1 + GEN 3.4: cancelling IFR terminates IFR service. State station, callsign, 'cancelling IFR', and that you're continuing VFR. SAR responsibility transfers to you.
